headline.before: I built the call funnel for your

bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 18 years of small caps. 10 YouTube subscribers.
beats.text: Your BYND short was featured by SMB Capital, and you've traded small caps for 18 years. But the channel you link everywhere has 10 subscribers, and your reels get a few dozen views. The trades are real. Almost nobody sees them.

beats.title: The work is already there.
beats.text: 104 videos, 15 of them uploaded on a single day, a textbook course, scanners, a Course 2 presale and 167 traders in your free Discord. The content exists. What's missing is a steady way to bring the right traders to it.

beats.title: Your coaching is a buy button for 30 minutes.
beats.text: $250 for half an hour, $400 for an hour, paid up front, then an email to schedule. Nobody gets asked what they trade or whether they're ready, and every session ends without a next step.

beats.title: “I don't have the audience for a funnel.” That's what it's for.
beats.text: A funnel with ads doesn't need a big channel. It needs proof, and you have it: 18 years and real trades on video. Ads bring small-cap traders to one page, the application filters them, the call decides. No income claims needed in the ads.
beats.quote: “I teach real-world small-cap stock trading through real trades, repeatable setups, and practical day trading strategies.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.body: By the time you see it on social media, the move is over and you're the exit liquidity.

cards.title: You trade the headline
cards.body: A news alert, a big green candle, and you're in before you know if the catalyst is real.

cards.title: One loss turns into five

mechanism.title: Always ask: why is it moving?
mechanism.body: Small caps move on catalysts, float and volume. You learn to verify the news, find the stocks before they run, trade a few repeatable setups and only take trades with at least 1:4 risk to reward. In the mentorship, Payd reviews your trades with you until the process is yours.

questions.q: How long have you been trading?
Can you trade during the first hours of the market?
What's the biggest thing holding your trading back right now?
Are you already in Payd's Discord or courses?
Do you only trade money you can afford to lose?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the mentorship now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the mentorship isn't the right next step for you. Join the free Discord and watch the trades on YouTube, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to trade small caps with a process?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Educational content only, not financial advice. Trading small-cap and low-float stocks is highly risky and you can lose your entire investment. Results are not typical and will vary from person to person. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades ready, wins and losses, and note your platform and scanner.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Payd

preCallEmails.subject: Always ask why it's moving
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most small-cap traders lose on stocks they never should have touched: no real catalyst, too late in the move, no plan for the exit.

The mentorship is built on one process: verify the catalyst, find it on the scanner, trade the setup, respect the 1:4 rule.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Payd

preCallEmails.subject: "I already bought the course"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know the setups.

The mentorship is for when knowing isn't enough: I go through your own trades with you, so you see where you break the process.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Payd

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Payd

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Payd's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Payd

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Payd
